data.to:
Read .lattice/notes/design-decisions-2026-07-04.md first. It binds this task.

Build most-abstracted archetype renderers for the visual families in the taxonomy: enclosure (nested ovals — the existing circle renderer is close), blocks (isometric stacking), trees, graph (nodes on a ring), map (centred), map, rooms (floor plan with door gaps), paths (re-entrant wiring). Plan all; sequence by rendering cost — enclosure, trees, blocks and graph are cheap; maps and rooms need planar layout; paths is hardest and may defer.

Rules:
- the dataset factory already handles image samples (the format=image path in datasets/factory.py); emit images the same way
- structure preservation must be machine-verified, for example by generating the image from a verified intermediate and parsing SVG back where possible
- colour cues that mark isomorphisms are for the site only; model stimuli stay uncued
- no evaluation runs in this task; the budget (100 to 150 US dollars per release) is spent elsewhere

Design renderers as archetype generators the DB-4 variation pipeline can wrap; read the DB-4 description before designing.

data.body: Holding planning until the rendering architecture doc from the DB-4 ultracode run lands. Archetype designs must target that pipeline.

Adversarial plan review (reviewer-b). VERDICT: PASS WITH FIXES.

Interface guessing (axis 1): mostly OK, correctly hedged ('re-check signatures against landed code'). All DB-4 symbols named (ARCHETYPE_REGISTRY, Primitive, ComposedRenderer, FormNode, containment_relation, relation_hash, BaseRender, Archetype/Injector, verify, emit, DIALECT_SPECS) exist in DB-4's plan. Two concrete mismatches: (a) DB-3 assumes core lives at src/lofbench/renderers/core.py; DB-4's plan puts it in the new package src/lofbench/renderers/pipeline/ (nodes.py etc). Hedged but wrong-as-written. (b) Milestone availability: DB-3 says it unblocks on 'DB-4 step 1' but its spatial archetypes need emit()->PNG, and the rasteriser (cairosvg/resvg) is not pinned until DB-4 M5 step 7, not M1. emit() is declared in M1 but is inert for spatial until the rasteriser lands. DB-3 can build+verify symbolic scenes after M1/M2 but cannot emit PNGs until M5. State this staging explicitly.

Swap confusion (axis 2): resolved correctly — DB-3 takes the nine-family visual taxonomy per live task descriptions, consistent with DB-2. HOWEVER a HIGH-severity double-plan: enclosure@1. DB-4 M5 step 7 explicitly reimplements svg_circle as enclosure@1 and calls it 'the only substantial code write' of DB-4. DB-3 family #1 ALSO claims this migration ('do the migration here rather than leaving it stranded'). Both plans schedule building enclosure@1, the circle alias, and its predicate tests. If both run they collide. Orchestrator MUST assign enclosure@1 to exactly one of DB-3/DB-4 and strike it from the other. This is the single biggest coordination defect across the two plans.

Determinism (axis 3): SOUND, not hand-waving. Decimal Taylor-series trig (General Decimal Arithmetic is correctly-rounded and libm-independent, so bit-identical cross-platform) + Fraction layouts + rational dimetric projection are genuinely deterministic. Crucially the plan keeps all predicate comparisons in Decimal/Fraction and converts to float only at final draw, so the containment predicate is exact — this correctly answers the arch doc's transcendental-straddles-the-rounding-cut concern. eps=1e-4 on the [-1.1,1.1] viewBox is comfortably above Decimal->float drift. stable_trig accuracy is irrelevant to predicate validity (only determinism matters) and the plan ships a math.sin tolerance test. Good.

Structure preservation (axis 4): mixed. Enclosure (circle-in-circle), blocks (3D interval-subset), map/rooms (rect_subset), map-centred (polar interval-subset) are genuinely discriminative geometric predicates on real coordinates — a broken layout fails them. BUT trees + graph use 'structural adjacency' (child in parent.children), which the archetype builds by walking FormNode directly — so induced_relation mirrors FormNode BY CONSTRUCTION and verify() ALWAYS passes regardless of geometry. A tree with all nodes stacked at one point, or mis-drawn edges, still reports structure_verified=True. The plan's defense ('catches dropped primitives / mis-wired distractors') is weak: dropped primitives are already caught by the node-map-exactly-once gate, and node_id=None distractors are excluded from the fold. So for trees/graph the predicate adds ~nothing and the acceptance criterion 'one deliberately tight case per family (grandparent-to-grandchild margin, or equivalent)' has no geometric content — the arch doc's 'tangent/touching must read as not-contained' hand-labelled-scene rule is unsatisfiable here. FIX: either add a geometric sanity predicate for trees/graph (e.g. edge actually connects the two node positions, child below parent in y) or explicitly document in the archetype docstring + acceptance criteria that geometry is UNVERIFIED for these two families and only symbolic parenthood is checked.

Also (axis 4, medium): map-centred polar predicate needs a seam convention. 'child angular interval subset of parent (mod one full turn)' is error-prone across the 0/2pi wrap; a wedge crossing the seam breaks a naive Fraction subset test. Pin the invariant (children partition the parent's contiguous span, no wedge crosses the seam) so the mod-arithmetic never actually wraps.

Taxonomy (axis 5): 8 of 9 image families covered by DB-3 (enclosure, trees, blocks, graph, map, map-centred, rooms) + parens covered by DB-4 M5. Only 'paths' is deferred — honestly, with a stated three-point feasibility case and a paths-lite arc-nest stand-in. map + map-centred are covered but visually diverge from the reference's blob/Voronoi look; flagged as an explicit cost/fidelity tradeoff, acceptable. Nothing silently missing.

PASS WITH FIXES: (1) HIGH — deconflict enclosure@1 double-plan with DB-4 M5 (orchestrator call); (2) trees/graph predicate is structural-by-construction — either strengthen it geometrically or document the non-verification honestly and fix the mismatched acceptance criterion; (3) pin the map-centred polar seam convention; (4) restate emit/rasteriser staging (spatial emit blocked until DB-4 M5, not M1); (5) fix guessed core path (pipeline/ package, not renderers/core.py). None plan-level; all implementation-level.

Review fixes applied: struck enclosure@1 as DB-3 work (DB-4 M5 owns it; DB-3 consumes it as the worked exemplar). Added rna_arc@1 to DB-3's scope, built alongside paths-lite (shared interval-nesting pattern). Added a geometric sanity predicate for trees (disc non-overlap, below-parent layout) and graph (edge-endpoint coincidence) on top of structural adjacency. Pinned the map-centred polar predicate's wraparound-safety invariant (contiguous partition, no seam-crossing wedges). Stated rasteriser staging (symbolic authoring after M1/M2, PNG emission after M5). Fixed the guessed renderers/core.py path to DB-4's actual renderers/pipeline/ layout.

Implementation complete on feat/DB-3-visual-archetypes (675a0c4), built on merged lattice tip d60714e (DB-4 M1/M2).

Families landed: trees@1, blocks@1, graph@1, map@1, map_centred@1, rooms@1, rna_arc@1, paths_lite@1 -- all 6 taxonomy families the plan assigned DB-3, plus the RNA arc worked example, plus the paths-lite stand-in the plan recommended over deferring paths entirely. Enclosure not built (DB-4 M5's, per disposition).

Geometry approach per family (all exact Fraction/Decimal, zero floats before predicate checks):
- trees: post-order integer/Fraction x-slots, y=depth; structural-adjacency predicate + geometric_sanity() (disc non-overlap, child strictly below parent) per the review fix.
- blocks: 1-D Fraction interval subdivision along x (leaf-weight), fixed y footprint, z=(depth,Z_TOP) "extends to the rim" trick for exact 3-D interval-subset containment; dimetric (x-y, x+y) projection, no trig.
- graph: N nodes at exact Fraction-of-turn angles via stable_sin/cos (Decimal Taylor series, never math.*); structural-adjacency predicate + geometric_sanity() (edge endpoints coincide with ring positions) per the review fix.
- map: slice-and-dice rect treemap, gaps via Fraction shrink, rect_subset predicate.
- map_centred: annular treemap; angular spans always represented as plain [lo,hi) Fraction subsets of [0,1) so the zero-seam wraparound invariant holds by construction (review fix); radial axis uses the same "extends to the rim" trick as blocks' z.
- rooms: reuses map's exact subdivision/rect_subset; door gaps are a purely cosmetic stroke break, no geometry/predicate change.
- rna_arc + paths_lite: shared nesting.py, leaf-position spans with a per-depth margin so single-child chains (same raw leaf range at every level) still nest strictly, not just non-strictly.

Deferred/deviations:
- No injectors implemented (plan's own "no injectors are implemented here beyond noting" reading); each module docstrings the injectors that would apply.
- Registration (archetypes/__init__.py) populates ARCHETYPE_REGISTRY and DIALECT_SPECS but withholds the register_renderer step: registering it makes every family reachable through lofsite's eager render-all-dialects sandbox, which has no guard for DB-4 M5's not-yet-landed spatial emit() and fails 5 lofsite tests. Filed as DB-9 (backlog) rather than silently editing lofsite/rendering.py or pipeline/emit.py, both outside this task's boundary. Un-deferring is a one-line change once DB-9 or M5 lands.
- map_centred's family string is "map_centred" (underscore); dialect_id keeps the plan's own hyphenated "map-centred.canonical-v1" slug.

Evidence: 885 new tests (determinism, predicate epsilon/tight-margin units incl. at least one deliberately tight case per family, containment-relation verification over 10 hand-picked + 60 generated forms spanning depth 1-5/branching 1-4 per family). `uv run pytest -q`: 6083 passed. `uv run ruff check` clean on all touched files. Manually verified all 8 archetypes' verify() against 300 random forms and confirmed generated SVG is well-formed XML (no local rasteriser available to render PNGs -- imagemagick's built-in SVG delegate here can't draw <circle>/<path> at all, confirmed independent of my code via a trivial test SVG; <rect>/<line>-only families like rooms rendered correctly, confirming coordinate systems are sane).

Conflict-surface: only shared file touched is renderers/__init__.py, one append-only import line placed after register_renderer is defined. No edits to pipeline/, dialects_text/, lofsite/, or DB-5's files.

REVIEW (agent:claire-reviewer-db3, cold review of commit 675a0c4 on feat/DB-3-visual-archetypes). VERDICT: PASS. No implementation or plan rework needed.

Gates: uv run pytest -> 6083 passed (29s); ruff check on touched files -> clean. tests/archetypes collects 877 tests.

Adversarial verification (scratch scripts, all green):
- Platform-stable arithmetic: only math refs are docstrings; no math.sin/cos/sqrt/pi in code. All float() confined to to_svg draw code except graph.py:61 (Decimal->float at build, deterministic, never touched by a predicate). stable_sin/cos match libm within 3e-16 at 0, pi/6, pi/4, quarter-turn, near-seam, pi, -pi, 3pi/2, 2pi-eps. Containment comparisons stay in Fraction; trig only crosses to Decimal/float at final draw.
- Containment fidelity: verify() == containment_relation for all 8 families across hand-derived ((())()) (|rel|=4, matches by hand), deep chain (((((())))))  (depth 6, |rel|=15), wide 9-sibling, void, (()), mixed; plus 20 random forms x 8 families = 160 verify() all ok.
- Near-miss / false-positive sweep on ((()())(()())): every family false_pos=0 false_neg=0. blocks/map_centred "extends-to-rim" z/radial axis confirmed non-spurious - cousin pairs get disjoint x/angle intervals, so the laminar axis is the real discriminator; the rim axis only contributes depth-ordering. Honest and documented.
- Geometric sanity predicates are real, not tautological: corrupting a trees node position to force disc overlap -> geometric_sanity False; shifting a graph node's stored ring position so edges no longer coincide -> False. graph's check reads node_map independently of the edge's copied coords, so its value is latent (base archetype copies verbatim) but correctly forward-designed for ring-position jitter injectors.
- map_centred seam: nested-mark form with wide angular partition -> verify ok, zero wedges wrap the zero seam; every span is a plain 0<=lo<hi<=1 Fraction sub-interval (no modular arithmetic), enforced by a parametrized test over all forms.
- Determinism: two fresh renders (seeds 0 vs 999; base ignores rng) byte-identical to_svg for all 8 families.
- SVG well-formedness: 160 SVGs (20 forms x 8) all parse via xml.dom.minidom.

Deviation judgments:
(a) Registration deferred behind _register_named_dialect_when_ready: CORRECT call, not over-caution. ARCHETYPE_REGISTRY and DIALECT_SPECS ARE populated at import (renderers/__init__.py:143 imports the package); only register_renderer is withheld. Verified the mechanism: register_named_dialect (spec.py:107) calls register_renderer, which makes the dialect visible to lofsite.render_all_dialects (rendering.py:59 iterates list_renderers() and calls render()), whose spatial path hits emit()'s NotImplementedError (emit.py:30, M5 scope) - breaking DB-6's already-green sandbox tests. Both files that would guard it are outside this task's boundary. Properly tracked as DB-9 (filed, "lofsite sandbox fan-out breaks on spatial dialects before DB-4 M5's emit() lands").
(b) No injectors implemented: consistent with the plan's dominant reading - every per-family section says "injectors noted, not implemented (out of scope per the plan)" and acceptance criteria don't require them. The plan's scope sentence is internally contradictory ("No injectors are implemented here beyond noting" vs "this task owns family-specific ones"), but the resolution taken is defensible and DB-4 owns the injector protocol.

Test quality (sampled ~12 across geometry/map_centred/nesting/registration): substantive, not padding. Explicit tight near-miss cases with exact Fraction (e.g. 10 + 1/10^9 -> rect_subset False), negative predicate cases (disjoint angular span -> False, bad z-axis -> False), accuracy-vs-libm AND bit-identical-determinism separated correctly, verification parametrized over 70 forms (10 hand-picked + 60 generated depth 1-5 branch 1-4) per family through the real verify() machinery. All fail-able.

Family fidelity vs demo/13--visual-transforms--colour.png: the 8 built families read as their taxonomy archetypes (node-link trees, ring graph, dimetric blocks, rect treemap, annular sunburst, floor-plan rooms, RNA arcs, staple paths). paths-lite is honestly labelled a stand-in for the literal re-entrant wiring panel, not a reproduction; map/map-centred are the documented closed-form treemap tradeoff against the reference's blob look. Enclosure correctly not built (DB-4 M5).

ONE acceptance criterion not met, by design: "reachable through the registry ... -T renderer=<dialect_id> resolves". Deferred. Leaving status at review rather than done.

ROUTING TO CLOSE DB-3: before done, two things must land: (1) DB-4 M5 (pinned rasteriser + emit()'s spatial path) so render() no longer raises; (2) DB-9's resolution (either M5's spatial emit or a lofsite render_all_dialects guard). Then the one-line un-deferral (_register_named_dialect_when_ready -> register_named_dialect) lands, registry reachability is satisfied, and DB-3 closes. Recommend orchestrator hold DB-3 at review/blocked-on-DB-4-M5+DB-9 rather than forcing done now.

Merged into lattice at commit 9b47800 (Merge DB-3: eight visual family archetypes with exact-arithmetic predicates [reviewed, pass]), on top of DB-4 M3-M5 (20e3901). Two expected conflicts, resolved per the reviewer's protocol: (1) src/lofbench/renderers/__init__.py -- kept both appended import hunks (DB-4's 'from . import archetypes, injectors' first, then DB-3's 'from . import archetypes as _archetypes'). (2) src/lofbench/renderers/archetypes/__init__.py (add/add) -- unioned both: DB-4's parens/pattern self-registering imports plus DB-3's eight family imports (blocks, graph, map_centred, map_rect, paths_lite, rna_arc, rooms, trees), merged docstring covering both registration paths, DB-3's deferred-registration guard (_register_named_dialect_when_ready) preserved unchanged so the lofsite sandbox fan-out gap (flagged as DB-9) stays exactly as DB-3 left it. Full suite green after merge: 6213 passed, 0 failed. No ruff/behavioral deltas introduced by the conflict resolution itself.

Correction to my prior comment: the merge did introduce one new ruff finding (I001, unsorted import block in renderers/archetypes/__init__.py -- the two separately-appended 'from . import ...' hunks weren't alphabetized together). Fixed in follow-up commit 55498e3 (ruff --fix, ruff-only change, no behavior change); full suite still green after (6213 passed). Total ruff findings are back to the reviewer's expected 14-15 pre-existing baseline, none in this file.

DB-4 M5-rest flip landed (branch feat/DB-4-pipeline-m5rest-m6-m7, commit b0f3b5c): pipeline.emit's spatial branch is real now (cairosvg-pinned PNG rasterisation via each archetype's own to_svg, wired centrally in renderers/archetypes/__init__.py without touching any DB-3 archetype module). _register_named_dialect_when_ready now delegates straight to register_named_dialect, so all eight DB-3 families (trees, blocks, graph, map, map-centred, rooms, rna_arc, paths_lite) are full renderer-registry entries: get_renderer(dialect_id) and -T renderer=<dialect_id> resolve them, and each renders a real data:image/png;base64 payload with structure_verified=True. Reachability through lofsite's render-all-dialects sandbox fan-out was also confirmed directly (no guard needed, no breakage) -- tests/test_lofsite.py's fan-out tests pass with all eight families registered, so the DB-6-fan-out-breakage contingency flagged at DB-3 review time did not materialize. Updated tests/archetypes/test_registration.py's TestSpatialEmitNotYetWired -> TestSpatialEmitWired (asserts a real PNG data URI per family) and its test_dialect_id_constructs_a_working_composed_renderer (now also asserts get_renderer(dialect_id) resolution). DB-3's own reachability acceptance criterion (deferred pending this exact landing, per the DB-3 review comment) is satisfied. Remaining DB-3 closure is review routing on your side.

Closure: spatial emit and the registration flip merged to lattice (20e3901 lineage, final merge of M5-M7). Reviewer agent:claire-reviewer-db4c confirmed all eight families resolve and render PNGs, satisfying DB-3's deferred reachability criterion. Reviews on record: agent:claire-reviewer-db3 (pass, archetypes) and agent:claire-reviewer-db4c (pass, flip).
